entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even Boss would've woken up with[n]how many times we've rung this[n]doorbell.
entries.uk: Ми стільки разів дзвонили, що навіть[n]шеф прокинувся б.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I would think Futaba would have[n]answered by now if she were here[n]too.
entries.uk: Якби Футаба була тут, вона, гадаю,[n]теж уже відповіла б.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, you can't go openin' other[n]people's stuff like that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But look. The door seems to be slightly[n]open as well.
entries.uk: Але гляньте. Двері, здається, теж[n]трохи прочинені.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder why. That's rather careless...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, it sounds like it's going to rain...[n]We should get inside!
entries.uk: Ого, схоже, зараз піде дощ...[n]Ходімо всередину!
